get.summary: Prometheus metrics (scrape endpoint)
get.description:
Exposes resource usage (CPU, memory, disk, event loop lag) and Angles application metrics (builds, executions, screenshots, HTTP requests) in the Prometheus text exposition format.

**Served from the server root, not the API base path**: the real URL is `GET /metrics`, not `GET /rest/api/v1.0/metrics`. It is mounted outside the API base path because Prometheus cannot hold a session cookie, so it authenticates with its own bearer token instead. ('Try it out' below will target the wrong URL for this reason.)

The endpoint returns 404 unless one of these is configured:
- `ANGLES_METRICS_TOKEN` - require this token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or in the `x-metrics-token` header (recommended).
- `ANGLES_METRICS_PUBLIC=true` - no authentication; only appropriate when the port is unreachable from outside the deployment network.

Related settings: `ANGLES_METRICS_CACHE_TTL_MS` (default 60000) caches the database aggregations between scrapes, `ANGLES_METRICS_MAX_SERIES` (default 200) caps per-team label cardinality, and `ANGLES_METRICS_DISK_USAGE=true` additionally walks the screenshot and compare directories to report how much disk Angles itself is using.

200.description: Metrics in the Prometheus text exposition format

text/plain.example:
# HELP angles_builds Number of builds stored, by status.
# TYPE angles_builds gauge
angles_builds{status="PASS"} 26

404.description: The metrics endpoint is disabled (neither ANGLES_METRICS_TOKEN nor ANGLES_METRICS_PUBLIC is set)

put.summary: Update a shared step, cascading into every referencing test case
put.description: Requires team lead access. Changing the steps bumps the shared step version and writes a new frozen version for every test case that includes it, re-expanded with the new content - so previously written versions keep showing what their tester saw. Renaming or re-describing the shared step changes no test case content and cascades to nothing. Check `cascade.testCasesVersioned` on the response, and call the usage endpoint first to see how many cases an edit will affect.

requestBody.description: The fields to update.

200.description: Shared step updated, with the cascade outcome

400.description: A step tried to include another shared step

403.description: Team lead access is required

409.description: A shared step with this name already exists for the team

delete.description: Requires team lead access. A shared step that any test case still includes cannot be deleted - the referencing cases would expand to an unresolved placeholder and silently lose steps. Remove the inclusions first; the usage endpoint lists them.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API token issued via 'POST /users/{userId}/tokens'. Paste the raw token value (only shown once, at creation time) to authorise the 'Try it out' requests.

MetricsBearerAuth.description: Value of the ANGLES_METRICS_TOKEN environment variable, used only by the Prometheus scrape endpoint.

x.description: Left edge of the matched region, in original screenshot pixels

y.description: Top edge of the matched region, in original screenshot pixels

scale.description: Template scale at which the match was found

executions.description: Optional test executions to store with the build, so the whole build can be created in a single call. Executions are grouped into suites by their 'suite' name and the build metrics are calculated from them. Omit this to add executions individually afterwards via POST /execution.

executionType.description: Whether the results came from an automated run or a manual test run. Defaults to "automated", so documents written before manual runs existed read back unchanged.

BuildExecution.description: An execution supplied as part of a POST /build request. Identical to Execution but without 'build', which is the build being created.

executionType.description: Whether the results came from an automated run or a manual test run. Defaults to "automated", so documents written before manual runs existed read back unchanged.

attachments.description: Images a QA attached while recording a manual step result. Automated runs use `screenshot` instead.

executionType.description: Whether the results came from an automated run or a manual test run. Defaults to "automated", so documents written before manual runs existed read back unchanged.

manualTestCase.description: On a manual execution, the test case it came from.

manualTestCaseVersion.description: The frozen version this execution was run against. Carried here as well as on the run entry, because an execution is reachable from the dashboard and the execution history without ever loading its run, and has to render the content it was executed against on its own.

versionNumber.description: Denormalised version number, for display without a join.

executedBy.description: The user who recorded a manual result.

executionType.description: Whether the results came from an automated run or a manual test run. Defaults to "automated", so documents written before manual runs existed read back unchanged.

token.description: Plain-text token — only returned once at creation time

order.description: Position of the step within the test case. Assigned from the array order when omitted.

expected.description: The expected result of performing the action.

data.description: Test data needed for this step (accounts, payloads, fixture references).

sharedStep.description: ID of a re-usable shared step this step includes. On a test case head this marks a placeholder: its own action and expected are ignored and the shared step is expanded in its place. A frozen version never carries this field - it stores the expanded steps instead, so a later edit to the shared step cannot rewrite history.

attachments.description: IDs of images attached to this step. Reference one from the expected result as `![alt](attachment:<id>)`; the UI resolves that to /attachment/<id>/file. Validated on write - an id that does not exist, or belongs to another team, is rejected.

sharedStepRef.description: Display attribution on an expanded step: the shared step it came from. Present on expanded output and on frozen versions, never on a head placeholder.

sharedStepVersion.description: Which revision of the shared step this step was expanded from.

unresolvedSharedStep.description: True when the referenced shared step no longer exists. The placeholder is kept rather than dropped so the case does not silently lose steps.

_id.description: Stable step id. Preserved into every frozen version so a recorded step result stays bound to the right step when later versions reorder or remove steps.

team.description: ID of the team that owns this test case.

component.description: ID of a component belonging to the team.

status.description: Workflow state. Changing it does not create a new version.

customFields.description: Values for the custom fields configured for the team, keyed by field key. Validated and coerced against those definitions: an unrecognised key is rejected rather than dropped, and required fields are enforced for any status other than DRAFT.

comment.description: Optional reason for the change, recorded on the change history entry rather than stored on the entity.

version.description: Current content version. Incremented only when content changes; always resolves to a document in the version history.

totalTestCases.description: Total matching the query, ignoring limit and skip.

ManualTestCaseVersion.description: An immutable copy of one version of a manual test case. These documents are only ever inserted - never updated or deleted - so an execution bound to a version always renders the content it was run against.

testCase.description: ID of the test case this is a version of.

fieldDefinitions.description: The custom field definitions in force when this version was written, so an archived or relabelled field still renders with its original label and type. Empty until custom fields are configurable.

unversioned.description: Present and true only when the case predates version tracking and the mutable head was returned instead of a frozen version. Such a response is not guaranteed immutable.

versions.description: Version metadata, newest first. Fetch a single version for its full frozen content.

team.description: ID of the team the field is configured for.

key.description: Stable storage key. A test case's customFields object is keyed by it, so it cannot be changed once created - create a new field instead.

label.description: Display name. Can be changed freely; every frozen version keeps the label that was in force when it was written.

type.description: Value type. Cannot be changed once any test case holds a value for the field.

options.description: Allowed values. Required for select and multiselect, rejected for every other type. An option still held by a test case cannot be removed.

required.description: Enforced only when a test case is saved with a status other than DRAFT, so an incomplete draft can always be saved.

defaultValue.description: Applied when a test case supplies no value. Never applied to an archived field.

order.description: Display order within the team's field list.

archived.description: Archived fields are hidden from authoring and exempt from the required check, but existing values still validate and render.
True when the field was in use and has been archived instead of removed. False when it was unused and hard-deleted.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe handle. Forms part of the login and callback URLs, so changing it changes what must be registered with the identity provider.

name.description: Label shown on the login button.

value.description: Group name, group id, or attribute value as supplied by the provider. Matched case-insensitively.

defaultRole.description: Role granted when no mapping matches. Empty denies access.

issuer.description: Issuer URL; endpoints and the JWKS come from its .well-known/openid-configuration.

clientSecret.description: Write-only. Never returned; send a non-empty value to change it, or omit/blank to keep the stored one.

scopes.description: Space-separated. openid is added automatically. Note Google rejects the groups scope, while Entra emits groups without one.

groupsClaim.description: Claim holding group membership - groups for Okta, often roles for Keycloak, a namespaced URI for Auth0.

usernameClaim.description: Claim used as the username. Falls back to email, then preferred_username, then sub.

idpCert.description: IdP signing certificate. Accepted with or without PEM armour. Required: assertions are only trustworthy because they verify against it.

issuer.description: This application's SP entity id, as registered with the IdP.

privateKey.description: Write-only. Only needed when the IdP requires signed AuthnRequests.

usernameAttribute.description: Attribute used as the username. Falls back to conventional email/name attributes, then the NameID.

wantAuthnResponseSigned.description: Require a signature over the whole Response, not just the assertion. Defaults to true; relax it for IdPs that sign only the assertion. The assertion signature is always required.

allowUnsolicited.description: Permit IdP-initiated login. Defaults to false: an unsolicited assertion has no AuthnRequest to correlate against, losing that replay protection.

url.description: Directory URL. Must be ldaps://, or ldap:// with startTLS enabled - this flow carries the user's password.

bindDN.description: Service account for the user search. Leave empty for an anonymous search.

searchFilter.description: {{username}} is substituted with the submitted username.

groupSearchBase.description: Leave empty to read membership from the user entry's memberOf attribute instead.

groupSearchFilter.description: {{dn}} is substituted with the user's DN.

tlsRejectUnauthorized.description: Defaults to true. Disabling it makes the connection interceptable, which here means intercepting passwords.

callbackUrl.description: The redirect/ACS URL to register with the identity provider.

team.description: ID of the team that owns the shared step.

steps.description: The steps to expand in place of an inclusion. Always literal - a shared step cannot include another shared step.

comment.description: Optional reason for the change, recorded on the change history entry rather than stored on the entity.

version.description: Incremented only when the steps change. Recorded on every expanded step so a frozen version shows which revision the tester saw.

testCases.description: The test cases whose head includes this shared step - the ones an edit would version.

cascade.description: What the edit did to the referencing test cases.

testCasesVersioned.description: How many test cases were given a new frozen version. Zero when only the name or description changed.

failures.description: Test cases that could not be versioned. The shared step edit itself still succeeded.

team.description: Taken from the entity the attachment hangs off, never from the request.

filename.description: Server-generated. The client filename is never used to build a path.

originalName.description: The uploaded filename, kept for display only and stripped of any directory component.

thumbnail.description: Path to the generated thumbnail. Absent when the image could not be thumbnailed; the original is still served.

ManualChangeHistoryEntry.description: One audited mutation. Distinct from a test case version: a version is the content a tester saw, while a history entry says who changed what and why. A status change and a shared-step cascade both write history without the version collection being able to express them.

action.description: STATUS_CHANGE is a transition that deliberately burns no version. SHARED_STEP_UPDATE marks a test case re-versioned because a shared step it includes was edited - nobody edited the case itself. ARCHIVE is a custom field that was in use and so could not be deleted.

version.description: The version the entity ended up on. Absent for custom fields, which are not versioned, and unchanged from the previous entry for an action that burns no version.

changes.description: Field-level changes. A steps change is broken down per position (`steps[2]`) and a custom field per key (`customFields.owner`), rather than reported as one opaque blob.

from.description: Previous value; type depends on the field.

to.description: New value; type depends on the field.

changedBy.description: Populated to _id and username only - the user document carries API tokens and must never leave the server through an audit endpoint.

comment.description: The author's reason, supplied as `comment` on the mutation, or a generated explanation for a cascade.

causedBy.description: On a SHARED_STEP_UPDATE entry, the shared step whose edit caused this case to be re-versioned.

totalEntries.description: Total for the entity, ignoring limit and skip.

stepId.description: The _id of the step in the frozen version. Binding by id rather than position means a reordered or deleted step in a later version cannot pull this result onto the wrong step.

attachments.description: Attachment ids captured against this step.

testCaseVersion.description: The frozen version being executed. Bound when the case is added to the run and never moved implicitly - editing the case mid-run must not shift the steps under the tester.

status.description: Richer than the execution status enum. BLOCKED and IN_PROGRESS exist only here; BLOCKED is written to the TestExecution as SKIPPED, since a blocked test was never executed and must not inflate the failure count.

execution.description: The TestExecution written for this case.

component.description: One component per run, matching Build.component. Defaults to the team's first component when omitted. A test case belonging to a different component is rejected.

environment.description: Environment name (not id), matching how POST /build takes it.

platforms.description: Reuses the automated Platform shape verbatim, so manual runs capture the same platform and device metrics and the platform aggregations need no new fields.

testCaseIds.description: Test cases to schedule. Each is bound to its current frozen version at the moment it is added. A DEPRECATED case is rejected.

build.description: The Build tagged executionType "manual" that this run's executions are written into, so the run appears on the existing dashboards.

status.description: Derived from the cases as results are recorded: COMPLETED once every case has a terminal result. CANCELLED is only ever set explicitly.

expanded.description: Present when the run was read with expand=true; each case then carries its frozen `version` document.

ExecutionTypeBreakdown.description: Executions in the period split by execution type. The two always sum to result.TOTAL, so a stacked chart built from it cannot under-report. Executions with no stored executionType count as automated.
